looks.label: Item glow pulse
looks.technique: tint eased down to about 0.4, then additive glow colour scaled by phase, one period per item

looks.label: Enchant reveal overlay
looks.technique: one-shot sprite overlay: fade-in 0.2 s, hold 1.0 s, fade-out 0.4 s, alpha 0.6

looks.label: Boss tint wave
looks.technique: sprite tint wobbles on a cosine once per second

looks.label: Stepped-crack blade glow
looks.technique: three glow states at different pulse periods (crystal enchant)

looks.label: Boss particle bursts
looks.technique: particle emitters on boss sprites for spray and charge sparks (per asset audit, not re-read)
